title: Google Docs
description: Reads Google Docs documents as plain text and appends text blocks with the org's bound Google account. The add-on calls the Docs API; the token stays host-side.

permissions.reason: Call the Google Docs API with the bound account
Use the Google account bound to the documents connection

tools.name: read_document
tools.description: Read a Google Docs document as plain text: paragraphs in order, table cells joined with tabs.

accountId.description: Bound Google account id; required only when several accounts are bound

tools.name: append_text
tools.description: Append a text block at the end of a Google Docs document as a new paragraph.
